name: Celestial Crowns
source:
On the Continent, Royals are thought to be descended from the gods that hang in the sky: the Planets. They appeared on Earth one day with incredible elemental powers. Their spellcrafting could freeze an entire army solid, sink a castle into the ground, rain lightning from the sky, or set a city ablaze.

Eventually, territories formed that became the existing kingdoms on the Continent, with the Royals crowned as their Monarchs. Nowadays, spellcrafting is considered a dead art. Most Royals have either lost the gift entirely as technology diminished the need or use it for mere parlor tricks.

You play as the newly crowned Monarch of Lauté with your kingdom on unsteady ground after your father's recent assassination. The first big challenge you face will shape the history of Laute forever:

The king of your neighbor Andromeda is so reclusive no one outside of his castle has ever seen his face. All that is known about him is that he is the last remaining Spellcrafter, and he has given you an ultimatum:

Accept his hand in marriage, or go to war.

[From [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/harlevin/celestial-crowns]Kickstarter[/url]]
translation:
在欧洲大陆，皇室成员被认为是天上诸神的后裔：行星。有一天，他们带着令人难以置信的元素力量出现在地球上。他们的法术可以冻结整支军队，将一座城堡沉入地下，从天上降下闪电，或者点燃一座城市。

最终，领土的形成成为了大陆上现存的王国，皇室加冕为他们的君主。如今，法术制作被认为是一门死亡的艺术。大多数皇室成员要么完全失去了这种天赋，因为技术减少了这种需求，要么只是将其用于客厅技巧。

你扮演新加冕的劳特君主，在你父亲最近被暗杀后，你的王国正处于不稳定的境地。你面临的第一个重大挑战将永远塑造劳特的历史：

你的邻居安德洛墨达的国王是如此隐居，他的城堡之外没有人见过他的脸。关于他，我们所知道的只是他是最后剩下的法术师，并且他给了你最后通牒：

接受他的婚姻，或者去战争。

[来自[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/harlevin/celestial-crowns]Kickstarter[/url]]
